dct_title_s: Pakistan & India: High Resolution Population Density Maps
dct_description_sm: Facebook and Columbia University - CIESIN provide the High Resolution Settlement Layer as the world's most accurate population datasets. More info can be found here: https://dataforgood.fb.com/tools/population-density-maps/ These maps are the distribution of human population spanning Pakistan and India. Each of the 13 TIFF files is a 10 x 10 degree tile (the lower latitude coordinate and longitude coordinates are in the file name). A VRT file is also included.
